application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

selection_process: The selection of Young Professional shall be done as per existing guidelines of Central Silk Board by the Screening Committee and the Selection of Committee Members to be constituted with the approval of Competent Authority. how_to_apply: Download the official notification PDF and application format (Annexure-I) from the links provided below.
Fill up the application in the prescribed format given in Annexure-I of the notification.

Attach self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets of educational qualifications, experience certificates issued by past employers or current employer, and documents in respect of other relevant details.
Forward the filled application along with requisite documents to the Central Silk Board email id: [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the specified email address on or before 06.11.2026. Any applications received after the last date will not be entertained.
important_instructions: The engagement of Young Professional will be purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of two years, which may be extended depending on the performance evaluation. The Young Professional shall not have the legal status on contract basis vis-a-vis in Central Silk Board as a 'staff member' or an 'official'. The remuneration will be inclusive of all applicable taxes and income tax or any other tax liable to be deducted at source. Working hours shall be as per office hours of Central Office, Central Silk Board normally from 9:30 am to 6:00 pm during working days. Paid leave shall be granted at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month. The engagement of Young Professional can be terminated at any time by the Central Silk Board by giving 30 days' notice or pay in lieu thereof, and vice versa. The Young Professional shall be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923. The Young Professional will be required to submit a police verification report from their concerned police station and also submit a medical-cum-fitness certificate prior to engagement.

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Young Professional posts at Central Silk Board.

rows.qualification_required: Regular Degree in Law (03 years degree after Graduation or 5 years integrated degree) entitling the incumbent for Registration at Bar and appearing before the Courts with minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent in Cumulative Grade Point System of marking) or LLM with minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent in Cumulative Grade Point System of marking) from any University in India or any Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission. Applicant should have proficiency in Computer operations. Proficiency in English and Hindi drafting, good analytical skills, and ability to manage multiple legal files simultaneously.

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Important Instructions

The Young Professional shall not have the legal status on contract basis vis-a-vis in Central Silk Board as a 'staff member' or an 'official'. The remuneration will be inclusive of all applicable taxes and income tax or any other tax liable to be deducted at source. Working hours shall be as per office hours of Central Office, Central Silk Board normally from 9:30 am to 6:00 pm during working days. Paid leave shall be granted at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month. The engagement of Young Professional can be terminated at any time by the Central Silk Board by giving 30 days' notice or pay in lieu thereof, and vice versa. The Young Professional shall be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923. The Young Professional will be required to submit a police verification report from their concerned police station and also submit a medical-cum-fitness certificate prior to engagement.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Central Silk Board (CSB), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, split into Young Professional Grade-2 (1 post) and Young Professional Grade-3 (1 post).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSB Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional Grade-2?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a regular Degree in Law (03 years or 5 years integrated) with a minimum of 60% marks or LLM with 55% marks, along with proficiency in computer operations and English and Hindi drafting.

faq.question: Q5. Is prior experience mandatory for Young Professional Grade-3?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience as a Legal Practitioner or experience in Legal Work in a Central/State Government Department, PSU, or Private Organisation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for CSB Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 1st July of the year of advertisement for both posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration for these posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration is 50,000/- per month for Young Professional Grade-2 and 70,000/- per month for Young Professional Grade-3.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application format given as Annexure-I in the notification, attach required self-attested documents, and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Where is the place of posting?
faq.answer: The place of posting is at the Central Office, Central Silk Board, Bengaluru.
